name: relate-phrases
description:
The class of each phrase at the other phrases of the table, the phrase it belongs to, its group and the reason.

A phrase is its words as lemmas; a preposition, a conjunction or a particle is dropped, except the question words (the bundled list @meaning/question) and the words to keep. A word with digits stays as it is. A unit is a word, or a run of words that a link source knows as one; two units are linked when a link source links them. The class: same (the same lemmas in any order, at an earlier row), variation (every unit pairs one to one with a unit of an earlier row, equal or linked, at least one pair linked), refinement (every unit of another phrase, of any row, pairs with a unit or a word of this one, and this one has units left over) or other. A phrase takes the best relation: same, then variation, then refinement; for a refinement the closest base (the most units), then the earliest row. The columns: class; of (the phrase it is same, a variation or a refinement of; empty for other); group (the first row among the phrases whose chains of `of` end in the same phrase); reason (lemmas; the links of the units; +word for each unit left over; for other the phrases that are its refinements, «base of: …», or the units unlinked to the nearest phrase, «unlinked: …»). An empty cell is other, with an empty group.
to: compare every phrase only with this one; of is this phrase or empty.
keep: more words a phrase never drops, as the question words.

Example: semkit read --text "разработка сайтов" --text "сайт разработка" --text "разработка сайтов под ключ" relate-phrases write -
-> разработка сайтов, other, , разработка сайтов, base of: сайт разработка | разработка сайтов под ключ; сайт разработка, same, разработка сайтов, разработка сайтов, lemmas; разработка сайтов под ключ, refinement, разработка сайтов, разработка сайтов, +ключ
Example: semkit read --text "угловой диван" --text "кресло" relate-phrases --to "диван" write -
-> угловой диван, refinement, диван, угловой диван, +угловой; кресло, other, , кресло, unlinked: кресло | диван

synonyms: a file of the groups of synonyms of the topic, read like `read` does; the items of a group are linked to each other (no chain across groups) and are compared by lemmas. Two shapes: a column synonyms, one group per row, the items split by | and an item may be several words (стиральная машина | стиралка | стиральная машинка); or the columns word and synonyms of `dupes --synonyms`, a word and its synonyms split by spaces. A group of one item is ignored. Example: --synonyms groups.csv, a file with the column synonyms and the row ремонт | починка | починить.

The step adds the columns class, of, group and reason right after the working column; the rows stay. The caller gives the phrases in its order (by frequency): the first phrase of a group is the one kept.

options.name: --to
options.description: compare every phrase only with this one; of is this phrase or empty.

options.name: --keep
options.description: more words a phrase never drops, as the question words. Items: a comma list 'a,b', @FILE (one item per line, or the first column of a table) or @NAME of a list.
